title: Adiabatic perturbation theory for the $F=1$ spinor nonlinear Schrödinger equation with nonvanishing boundary conditions
summary: We develop a systematic adiabatic perturbation theory for the integrable $F=1$ spinor nonlinear Schrödinger equation under nonvanishing boundary conditions, formulated entirely within the framework of the associated Riemann--Hilbert problem. In this setting, localized nonlinear excitations are characterized by discrete spectral data consisting of a complex eigenvalue and an associated polarization vector.
